statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-41520 is in the cilium-bugtool / cilium sysdump support-archive tooling, which writes the cilium_wg0.key WireGuard private key into debug archives. hubble-ui-backend is a gRPC/HTTP API server that only consumes cilium's flow types and client libraries to talk to hubble-relay; it does not invoke cilium-bugtool, does not read or write WireGuard key material, and does not generate sysdump archives. The vulnerable code path is not reachable from the backend binary regardless of cluster WireGuard configuration.
